Depot walkthrough

A practice page. The player carries no footage, which is all these bookmarklets need from it.

Try these on this page

  • Video - take video notes: adds a notebox beside the player.
  • Note - take page notes: the same notebox without the player part.

The player

An embedded frame

Some of these bookmarklets treat a frame the way they treat a player, so there is one of each on this page.

Taking notes

The note-taking bookmarklets keep what you type in the page and nowhere else, so reloading loses it. That is worth knowing before you write anything long in one.
